API pública da Régua de Cobrança — a rég: Collection Flow — Kobana’s collection engine public API. Manage customers, charges, collection rules, agreements, disputes and webhooks programmatically. Authenticate with a Kobana Account access token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`), an RS256 JWT issued by the Kobana authorization server; access is limited by the token’s scopes — the resource (`dunning/charges`) and the access level (`read`, `write`, `delete`, `import`, `export`, `all`).
Abre uma disputa sobre uma cobrança e pa: Opens a dispute against a charge and immediately pauses the collection rule. If the charge already has an open or under-review dispute, the existing one is returned (no duplicates). Supports `Idempotency-Key`.
Access token no header `Authorization: B: Access token in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. An RS256 JWT issued by the Kobana authorization server (`account.kobana.com.br`), with `aud` equal to `https://api.dunning.kobana.com.br` and a required `exp` — this API only verifies tokens, it issues none. Each request requires ONE access level: `GET` reads (`read`, `write` or `all`), `DELETE` deletes (`delete` or `all`), bulk imports and exports require `import`/`export` (or `all`) and everything else writes (`write` or `all`) — one level never stands in for another. A token with no scope this API recognizes reaches only `GET /v1/me`; account administration (members, roles, keys) is never available via API.

Agenda a geração do CSV num worker, sem: Schedules CSV generation on a worker, without the 10k-row cap of the synchronous mode and without blocking the request. Track status via GET /exports/jobs and download the file via GET /exports/jobs/{id}/download before `expires_at`. Responds 202. Requires the `export` access level (or `all`) — `read` and `write` are not enough.

Every delivery sends the headers `X-Webhook-Event` (event type), `X-Webhook-Event-Id`, `X-Webhook-Delivery-Id`, `X-Webhook-Attempt`, `X-Webhook-Timestamp` (ISO 8601) and `X-Webhook-Signature` formatted as `t=<unix>,v1=<hex>` — HMAC-SHA256 of `"{t}.{body}"` with the endpoint secret; verify the signature and reject `t` outside a 5-minute window (anti-replay) before processing.
